act.instructions: A financial adviser typed `message` to the assistant inside Content Studio, the app where they write, plan and track their social media posts. Which one thing is the message asking the app to do right now?

criteria.move: Schedule one of their saved posts, or move it to another day or time: put it on the calendar, reschedule it, change when it goes out.
criteria.write: Change the words of one of their saved posts: rewrite it, shorten or lengthen it, change its tone, fix it or add something to it.
criteria.week: Show how their posts did over the last week: their numbers, results, impressions, engagement, best or weakest post.
criteria.engage_replies: Help them reply to comments people left on their own post. The message contains those comments.
criteria.engage_dms: Help them reply to several separate direct messages from different people. The message contains those messages.
criteria.engage_thread: Help them reply in one back-and-forth direct message conversation with one person. The message contains that conversation.
criteria.engage_comment: Help them write a comment to leave on someone else's post. The message contains that post.
criteria.remember: Tell the app a lasting preference for what it makes from now on: always or never do something in their posts, videos or pictures, for example 'never use emoji', 'always end with a question', 'use Asian presenters'.
criteria.remix: Make their own version of a post, ad, reel or video someone else made: remix it, copy its idea or format, or do one like it. The message has a link, or a post is attached to it.
criteria.make: Make a new piece of content from a topic or idea: a post, a carousel, a script, a talking video, an explainer video or a picture.
criteria.competitor: Add a business, brand or social account to the competitors they track.
criteria.campaign: Plan a campaign, a month of posts or several weeks of content.
criteria.capabilities: Ask what the assistant can do, make or help with.
criteria.refuse: Ask for something that must not be made: a post that promises returns, a percentage or results, or guarantees them; names an insurer's product; copies another person's words exactly; uses another real person's face or voice; or makes a real person (a celebrity, a public figure or anyone who is not them) appear to say, recommend or endorse something.
criteria.budget: Ask how many AI videos, pictures, voiceovers or other AI uses they have left today, or what something costs to make.
criteria.forget: Take something back: undo the last change, forget a preference they gave earlier, or stop doing something the app was told to do.
criteria.memory: Ask what the app remembers, has learned or follows about them and their preferences.
criteria.check: Check one of their saved posts before it goes out: compliance, facts, whether it sounds human, how it might do.
criteria.approve: Say an explicit yes to the proposal waiting for them, `pending`: approve it, go ahead, do it, make it. A bare acknowledgement such as ok, okay, noted, got it or thanks is not a yes.
criteria.decline: Say no to the proposal waiting for them, `pending`: not now, cancel it, don't make it.
criteria.edit: Change the carousel that is open on screen right now, "Three CPF myths": its words, length, tone, captions, look, or the order of its slides.
criteria.answer: Answer or respond to a competitor's new ad or post with a post of their own.
criteria.none: Anything else: a question about how the app works, an idea, a problem or bug, a feature request, a message for the team, small talk, or something the app cannot do.
